01a0daa5-62b5-79a2-92bf-0337d8e39fbc.text: Largely realized by platform Decision 45: a fresh-named application vocabulary, owned by the specification, is now the graph people query and export, with file and line, and the ontology is its mapping to CCO. Work continues in [[emit-the-ontology]]; close this bet when that vocabulary ships, or narrow it to whatever remains.
